reviews.title: Only lasted a year and a half, I expect more quality for a high end video card
reviews.comment: The single star review is solely on the fact that I purchased in Dec '22 and the unit quit working Aug '24.  that's only a year and a half of usage and it no longer posts.  Otherwise the card performed very well for my Solidworks usage.
reviews.author: bkrengineer

reviews.title: system crash all the time, don't buy this
reviews.comment: I can't install any of the AMD drivers online either the current version or any historical versions. The system freezes at 97% and the monitor even squeaks at that percentage. Bought a graphics card for its 6 monitors output but end up with a brick. I searched online. There are a ton of users with the similar experience. Don't buy this.
reviews.author: Jiayu Zhang

reviews.title: This worked well in my workstation
reviews.comment: This was recommended and this brand comes standard with my Thinkstation 620 in about 10 different models. It is designed for CAD use and not really games but still does well at everything. It is not a gaming first device. I used Performance test and it did well.
reviews.author: Jim
